pages.text: Create: Wizardry connects Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks mana to Create machinery: collect mana, pipe it, and cast spells from a contraption. See $(l:exploration/magic)Magic$(/l).

pages.title: Mana Siphon
pages.text: Gathers mana from around it and from spellcasting mobs, and produces Mana Crystals for Arcane Essence.

pages.title: Arcane Pipe
pages.text: Mana moves in pipes like fluids. Long runs (over about 20 blocks) leak, so insulate them with Arcane Sheets. The Channeler harvests Liquid Lightning.

pages.title: Blaze Caster
pages.text: Casts a spell from a scroll and must be superheated. Some spells are incompatible with it.
